notes: §1985:VI.6.18.3 SR2: 'Identifier-3, ... , identifier-n must reference an elementary item described, implicitly or explicitly, as USAGE IS DISPLAY.' InspectBinder.InspectCharOperand binds every identifier-3 through identifier-7 position (ALL/LEADING/FIRST operand, BEFORE/AFTER INITIAL, BY, CONVERTING ... TO) and StatementValidation.CheckInspectOperandUsage refuses one that IsInspectElementaryCharacterItem rejects (an elementary reference whose ItemCategory.IsDisplayOrNationalUsage holds; a reference-modified item counts as elementary), CheckInspectFunctionUsage a numeric function (FunctionIsNotDisplayOrNational). The 2023 'or national' admits nothing extra at 85 because national data, N literals and NATIONAL-OF are refused there by their own gates. Probes (work-rr-04/i*.cob): b) group as identifier-3 (i1), -4 BEFORE INITIAL (i2), -5 BY (i3), -6/-7 CONVERTING G TO H (i4, both named), COMP item as -5 and -4 (i5, i6), USAGE INDEX as -3 (i7), COMP as -7 (i8), FUNCTION LENGTH as -3 (i13): COBOL0847 each, the witness COMP item too; d) legal elementary DISPLAY operands run: G1 BEFORE INITIAL "C" 02, unsigned numeric PIC 9 08, numeric edited W-E(2:1) as BY leaves Y unchanged, signed S9 VALUE -1 counted as '1' (06, inspected as unsigned per §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR3c), FUNCTION UPPER-CASE("a") 05; a) ODO element T-E(T-CNT) 09, the group slice T(1:2) as identifier-6 gives ZYZYCZYZZY, W-X(1:) 05, X(11:1) past the end COBOL2670; f) a subscript the statement changes, TALLYING S FOR ALL T-E(S), is evaluated once (S=6); c) N"A" COBOL0900 and NATIONAL-OF COBOL1502 at 85. Class e has no file arm. The witness refuses a COMP identifier-3.

next.reason: 1985: "must reference an elementary item described, implicitly or explicitly, as USAGE IS DISPLAY."; 2023: "shall reference an elementary item described implicitly or explicitly as usage display or national.". Same constraint on identifier-3 through identifier-n, but 2023 adds usage national as a permitted case. Programs using national items there are now accepted.
